app_identity.name: RASA — Aplikasi Penggajian RUMAT
app_identity.description: Automated Indonesian Payroll HRIS system featuring waterfall attendance penalty, BPJS calculation with UMK Bekasi floor, PPh21 TER (Taraf Efektif Rata-Rata), HRD review/approve/lock workbench with two-column split, sticky real-time THP bar with terbilang rupiah, and employee mobile PWA interface with password-protected PDF payslips.
app_identity.persona: RUMAT: tenang, klinis, terpercaya — satu keluarga visual dengan ROSY & RUMATku

color_system._aturan: Satu warna brand untuk SEMUA aplikasi RUMAT (ROSY, RASA, RUMATku). Pakai kelas Tailwind brand-* dari tailwind.config.js. DILARANG blue-*, indigo-*, atau hex baru di JSX.

peran.header_aplikasi: brand-700 (teal medis), menu aktif putih dengan teks brand-700

makna_status.bahaya_hanya_untuk_masalah: rose-600/700 (poin denda, ditolak, gagal). Potongan normal (BPJS, PPh, total potongan) BUKAN merah: slate-700

typography._aturan: Satu font: Nunito Sans (di-host sendiri di src/fonts, tanpa Google Fonts). Angka/rupiah memakai font yang sama + kelas .num (tabular-nums). DILARANG font monospace untuk angka.
typography.primary_font: Nunito Sans Variable, Nunito Sans, system-ui, sans-serif

hierarchy.judul_panel: text-base font-bold text-slate-900 (bukan huruf kapital semua)
hierarchy.label_kartu: text-sm font-semibold text-slate-600 (bukan huruf kapital semua)
hierarchy.header_tabel: text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-500 (satu-satunya tempat huruf kapital semua)

hrd_workbench.header: sticky top-0 z-40 bg-slate-900 text-white shadow-md border-b border-slate-800 px-6 py-3 flex items-center justify-between
hrd_workbench.left_column_earnings: bg-white p-6 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 shadow-sm space-y-4
hrd_workbench.right_column_deductions: bg-white p-6 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 shadow-sm space-y-4
hrd_workbench.bottom_sticky_bar: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 bg-white/95 backdrop-blur-md border-t-2 border-emerald-500 shadow-[0_-4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] px-6 py-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-4

employee_mobile.container: max-w-md mx-auto min-h-screen bg-slate-50 pb-20 relative shadow-xl border-x border-slate-200
employee_mobile.hero_card: relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-br from-teal-800 via-teal-600 to-teal-500 text-white p-6 shadow-lg mb-6
employee_mobile.floating_action_button: fixed bottom-6 right-6 sm:right-[calc(50vw-200px)] z-50 bg-teal-600 hover:bg-teal-700 text-white font-semibold py-3 px-5 rounded-full shadow-2xl flex items-center gap-2 transition-all transform hover:scale-105 active:scale-95

role_switching.description: Toggle navigation bar at top to switch seamlessly between HRD Manager Portal (ROSY) and Employee Mobile View (Rumatku).

features: Period list with status badges (Draft, Calculated, Reviewed, Approved, Locked)
Summary stats cards: Total Payroll Amount, Total Employees, Pending Reviews, Average PPh21
Quick Action: Batch Process Calculation with Progress Overlay
Payroll Configuration Panel (UMK Bekasi Floor, BPJS Ceiling Caps, Work Days standard)

attendance_log.description: Waterfall attendance penalty matrix calculator (Daily check-in/out, Late arrival tiers 1-3, Alpha penalty = Basic Salary/Workdays, Early leave penalty).

right_column: BPJS Kesehatan (1% Employee, UMK Bekasi floor applied)
PPh 21 TER (Auto-calculated category A/B/C rate based on Gross)
workbench_detail.sticky_bar: Displays live Total Penerimaan, Total Potongan, Net Take Home Pay (THP) in large green text, plus Terbilang (Rupiah in words, e.g. 'Delapan Juta Lapan Ratus Ribu Rupiah'), and Action Buttons (Simpan Draft, Setujui, Kunci Periode).

features: Hero Card: Periode Gaji (e.g. Maret 2026), THP Large Display, Transfer Status Badge (BERHASIL DITRANSFER), Bank BSI account suffix
Accordion: Rincian Penerimaan & Potongan Breakdown with progress bars
Security Badge: 'File PDF dilindungi sandi 6 digit tanggal lahir Anda (DDMMYY)'
Floating Action Button: 'Unduh Slip Gaji (PDF)' with interactive PDF Preview modal & DDMMYY unlock simulation

editable_amber_input.classes: bg-amber-100/80 border-2 border-amber-400 focus:border-amber-600 focus:bg-amber-50 text-slate-900 font-semibold px-3 py-1.5 rounded text-right tabular-nums transition-all outline-none shadow-inner
editable_amber_input.usage: Used ONLY for editable values in HRD Workbench (Lembur, KPI, Bonus, Kompensasi Denda, Kasbon).

component_guidelines.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, select, modal triggers, tables, switches) MUST include kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='input-overtime-hours', data-testid='btn-approve-payroll', data-testid='download-pdf-fab').

tombol._aturan: Maksimal 3 gaya tombol di satu baris aksi: primary (Btn variant=primary, brand-700), outline netral (variant=outline), dan bahaya (outline rose) hanya untuk aksi menolak/menghapus. Tinggi minimal 40px (sentuh di tablet).

component_guidelines.bahasa_ui: Bahasa Indonesia baku. Istilah Inggris hanya yang sudah baku di HRD RUMAT dan disepakati tim (lihat glosarium di CLAUDE.md).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Follow exact Indonesian tax & BPJS rules: PPh21 TER (Category A, B, C based on PTKP status TK/0, K/0, etc.), BPJS Kesehatan 1% employee (max cap Rp 12M, UMK Bekasi floor Rp 5.343.430), BPJS JP 1% employee (max cap Rp 10.042.300).
Waterfall attendance penalty rules: Alpha = Gaji Pokok / Total Hari Kerja; Terlambat Tier 1 (<15m) = Rp 25.000, Tier 2 (15-45m) = Rp 50.000, Tier 3 (>45m) = Rp 100.000 + Potongan Proporsional Jam.
Ensure every input element has proper data-testid attributes for E2E automated testing.
Implement real-time recalculation in the two-column HRD workbench whenever an Amber editable field (Lembur, Insentif KPI, Bonus, Kasbon) is changed.
Bottom Sticky Bar must update Net THP and 'Terbilang' string instantly on input changes.
Ensure employee mobile view is optimized for mobile screen ratios (375px - 430px) with card accordion layout and working PDF download trigger with password hint (DDMMYY).
